meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 安装后,当你要求从 OpenClaw 迁移时,Claude 会检测本机的 OpenClaw 安装,读取其中的身份、聊天频道、计划任务等配置,然后通过问答与你商量要迁移哪些内容,展示改动的样子后再执行。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from openclaw”“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenClaw 迁到 NanoClaw
say.note: Claude 会开始检测现有安装并引导迁移。

say.text: 我想从 OpenClaw 导入配置
say.note: 它会先扫描配置,再和你确认导入内容。

say.text: 开始 OpenClaw 迁移流程
say.note: 进入逐项迁移,先做环境发现。

howto.what_en: After install, on migration request, Claude finds OpenClaw, extracts identity, channels, scheduled tasks and config, then guides an interactive migration: discusses, shows changes, applies them to NanoClaw v2.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'migrate from openclaw', 'openclaw migration', or 'import from openclaw'.

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Claude detects the install and guides migration.

say_en.text: I want to import my config from OpenClaw
say_en.note: It scans the config first and confirms what to import.
Enters step-by-step migration, starting with discovery.
